metaDescription: BPI Mg 9 mungbean is a mungbean variety. About 60 days to harvest, 1.1 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits. Compare it with others.
excerpt: BPI Mg 9 is a registered mungbean variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1989. It takes about 60 days from sowing to harvest, with 1.05 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about BPI Mg 9 mungbean
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

BPI Mg 9 mungbean takes about 60 days from sowing to harvest. That is about the average of the 33 mungbean varieties with a day count, 59.8 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.05 t/ha trails the average of its group, 1.25. It sits in the lower quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It was weak against powdery mildew, so scout for it from the early weeks. Read up on [powdery mildew](/diseases/powdery-mildew), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot).

The pests and diseases that hit mungbean fields most often: [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer), [thrips](/pests/thrips). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant BPI Mg 9 mungbean

Munggo is ready in about two months, so it fits the gap after rice. Pick a variety that ripens its pods together, which saves picking rounds, and one rated against cercospora leaf spot and powdery mildew.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 60 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.05 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of BPI Mg 9?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
